Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1078
Claimant:
Michael Carter
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
May 25, 2023
Claim opened for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. Claimant
is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office. Driver is confirmed as a
named driver on the policy.
July 9, 2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was inside the vehicle at the time of impact and
that the collision happened as described. Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed and show the other driver's
account matches the position of both cars.
July 29, 2023
Damage to the rear bumper and tailgate is consistent with the impact described and with the force reported by the
other driver. No prior damage to this area of the vehicle appears in the file, and nothing indicates the damage
prdeates the satrt of coverage.
September 11, 2023
Claimant reports neck and upper back pain consistent with whiplash from the impact. No earlier injury to the same
body area is known from the medical history provided, and the injury pattern fits the kind and force of the crash.
October 30, 2023
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with physiotherapy and follow-up visits continuing.
Counsel has been asked for the treatment records and an update on expected recovery. Claimant has added some
small details since the first statement, but the core account has not changed.
December 25, 2023
File reviewed against the policy and the loss facts; all coverage conditions appear to be met. Reserve set pending
receipt of medical records and the attorney's demand package. Next review scheduled once those documents arrive.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
